correctness.rationale: The exact finite certificate is complete because every factor of a length-L uniform-morphic fixed point occurs within the image of an allowed adjacent pair of letters at a power-of-two block scale. Eight left-special length-five four-letter factors have exactly ac and db preceding contexts; projection is injective from length eight onward, so every long binary left-special suffix has both 01 and 10 contexts. Using Berthé Theorem 4 and recurrence gives exactly eight such suffixes. A complete length-12 tortoise fiber census has eight doubletons and no other collisions, and the prefix inheritance lemma plus no 00000 factors forces all long collisions to be those doubletons. All critical finite assertions were rerun from the embedded program and output.
